summary.name: Cursor
summary.one_liner: Cursor is an AI coding agent and code editor that turns ideas into code and runs tasks autonomously in parallel, across desktop, terminal, Slack and GitHub.
keywords: hand off coding tasks to ai
use_cases: Handing off coding tasks to autonomous agents
Running multiple coding agents in parallel
Reviewing pull requests in GitHub with AI
Getting command-line coding assistance in a terminal
Building and testing features end to end with agents
Writing code with autocomplete and AI chat in an editor
summary.what_it_does: Cursor is presented as a coding agent for building software, with a desktop IDE, a CLI and integrations for Slack and GitHub. Agents can take tasks handed off from the user, run in parallel, and use their own computers to build, test and demo features for review. Cursor runs in the terminal, collaborates in Slack and reviews PRs in GitHub. The page says users can choose among models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, SpaceXAI and Cursor itself. It also mentions bots that can sign in to tools and return finished work. The page includes a CLI install command (curl https://cursor.com/install).
notable: Agents run autonomously in parallel and use their own computers to build and test features
Choice of models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, SpaceXAI and Cursor
Integrates with terminal CLI, Slack and GitHub PR reviews
Listed in awesome-mac under Text Editors as freeware
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Long-running parallel agent fleets are described for hours or days; access limits are not specified
